# Just One API Docs

Official documentation for Just One API - All-in-one API Integration Platform.
Professional, stable, and efficient all-in-one data integration service, covering high-quality API interfaces in multiple fields.

## Core Information
- Website: https://docs.justoneapi.com/
- Main Languages: English (en), Simplified Chinese (zh)
- OpenAPI Release ID: `020eb8317b33ea29`
- Authentication: Follow each endpoint's OpenAPI declaration. Keep required `token` values in the declared parameter or request-body location; for standard OpenAPI security requirements, use one complete declared alternative and all schemes within that alternative.
- Authentication declarations in the current specification: Required token in form-encoded request body (14 endpoints); Required token in query parameter (289 endpoints).
- API Servers (OpenAPI declaration order):
  - Default: `https://api.justoneapi.com` — Global production API (default)

## API Categories & Endpoints

### Social Media / 社交媒体

Cross-platform social media discovery, monitoring, and trend research across supported content platforms. / 跨平台社交媒体发现、监控和趋势研究，覆盖所支持的内容平台。

- [Cross-Platform Search (V1) / 跨平台搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/social-media/cross-platform-search-v1): Searches recent content across news, Weibo, WeChat, Zhihu, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, and Kuaishou with source and time filters. Use it to monitor a topic across multiple platforms. / 搜索新闻、微博、微信、知乎、抖音、小红书、哔哩哔哩和快手上的最新内容，可按来源和时间过滤。用于跨平台监控话题。

### Taobao and Tmall / 淘宝和天猫

Taobao and Tmall marketplace product, review, search, and shop catalog data for commerce intelligence workflows. / 淘宝和天猫市场商品、评价、搜索和店铺目录数据，用于商业智能工作流程。

- [Product Details (V1) / 商品详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v1): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the V1 endpoint. Use it to perform direct product lookup for catalog research, product monitoring, or ecommerce analysis. / 通过V1接口按商品ID获取淘宝或天猫商品详情。用于直接商品查找，进行目录研究、商品监控或电商分析。
  - Limitations and conditions: Price: Returns the original product price. SKU prices are available for some products and may be absent for others. / 价格: 返回商品原价。部分商品提供SKU价格，其他商品可能没有。; Description images: Description images are included in description HTML and need to be extracted; a separate image list is not provided. / 描述图片: 描述图片包含在描述HTML中，需要提取；不提供单独的图片列表。; Some products may not be available through this endpoint. / 某些商品可能无法通过此接口获取。
- [Product Details (V3) / 商品详情 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v3): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the V3 endpoint. Use it to perform direct product lookup for catalog research, product monitoring, or ecommerce analysis. / 通过 V3 接口根据商品 ID 获取淘宝或天猫商品详情。用于进行直接商品查询，以支持目录研究、商品监控或电商分析。
- [Product Details (V4) / 商品详情 (V4)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v4): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the V4 endpoint. Use it to perform direct product lookup for catalog research, product monitoring, or ecommerce analysis. / 通过V4接口根据商品ID获取淘宝或天猫商品详情。用于执行直接商品查询，以进行目录研究、商品监控或电商分析。
  - Limitations and conditions: Price: Returns the original product price and SKU prices. Final product and SKU prices are available for some products. / 价格: 返回商品原价和SKU价格。部分商品提供最终商品价格和SKU价格。; Attributes: A product-parameter table was not returned in the verified samples. / 属性: 验证样本中未返回商品参数表。; Description images: Description images and description HTML were not returned in the verified samples. / 描述图片: 验证样本中未返回描述图片和描述HTML。; Some products may not be available through this endpoint. / 某些商品可能无法通过此接口获取。
- [Product Details (V5) / 商品详情 (V5)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v5): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the V5 endpoint. Use it to perform direct product lookup for catalog research, product monitoring, or ecommerce analysis. / 通过V5接口根据商品ID获取淘宝或天猫商品详情。用于执行直接商品查询，以进行目录研究、商品监控或电商分析。
  - Limitations and conditions: Some products may not be available through this endpoint. / 某些商品可能无法通过此接口获取。
- [Product Details (V6) / 商品详情 (V6)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v6): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the recommended V6 endpoint, including approximate sales, shipping fees and free-shipping status. Use it for product research and ecommerce monitoring. / 通过推荐的V6接口按商品ID获取淘宝或天猫商品详情，包括预估销量、运费和包邮状态。用于商品研究和电商监控。
- [Product Details (V8) / 商品详情 (V8)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v8): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the V8 endpoint, which provides accurate SKU quantity information. Use it to perform direct product lookup for catalog research, product monitoring, or ecommerce analysis. / 通过 V8 接口按 item ID 检索淘宝或天猫商品详情，该接口提供准确的 SKU 数量信息。可用于执行直接商品查询，以进行目录研究、商品监控或电商分析。
  - Limitations and conditions: Price: Returns the original product price and SKU prices. For pre-sale products, distinguish the deposit from the total price. / 价格: 返回商品原价和SKU价格。对于预售商品，请区分定金和总价。; Description images: Verified samples return an empty description-image list and a description retrieval URL. Further retrieval is required to obtain the images. / 描述图片: 验证样本返回空的描述图片列表和描述获取URL。需要进一步获取才能获得图片。; This endpoint may occasionally fail due to rate limiting; retry the request when it fails. / 该接口可能因限流偶尔失败；失败时请重试请求。
- [Product Details (V9) / 商品详情 (V9)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-details-v9): Retrieves Taobao or Tmall product details by item ID through the V9 endpoint. Use it to perform direct product lookup for catalog research, product monitoring, or ecommerce analysis. / 通过V9接口根据商品ID获取淘宝或天猫商品详情。用于执行直接商品查询，以进行目录研究、商品监控或电商分析。
  - Limitations and conditions: Description images: Description images are included in description HTML and need to be extracted; a separate image list is not provided. / 描述图片: 描述图片包含在描述HTML中，需要提取；不提供单独的图片列表。; Some products may not be available through this endpoint. / 某些商品可能无法通过此接口获取。
- [Product Reviews (V3) / 商品评价 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-reviews-v3): Retrieves Taobao and Tmall product reviews by item ID with page-based pagination and configurable sorting. Use it to analyze customer feedback. / 通过商品ID以分页和可配置排序方式获取淘宝和天猫的商品评价。用于分析客户反馈。
- [Product Questions (V1) / 商品问答 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-questions-v1): Retrieves the Taobao or Tmall product social feed by item ID with page-based pagination. Use it to review product questions and related discussion during customer-concern or product research. / 通过商品ID获取淘宝或天猫商品社交动态，支持基于页面的分页。用于在客户关注或产品研究期间查看商品问题和相关讨论。
- [Shop Product List (V1) / 店铺商品列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/shop-product-list-v1): Retrieves products from a Taobao or Tmall shop by seller or user ID, with page-based pagination and default or sales sorting. Use it to browse or monitor a seller catalog. / 通过卖家或用户ID获取淘宝或天猫店铺的商品，支持基于页面的分页和默认或销量排序。用于浏览或监控卖家目录。
  - Limitations and conditions: For some stores, the returned product list may be empty. / 对于某些店铺，返回的商品列表可能为空。
- [Shop Product List (V2) / 店铺商品列表 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/shop-product-list-v2): Retrieves products from a Taobao or Tmall shop using both seller or user ID and shop ID, with page-based pagination and sorting by sales, new arrivals, credit, or price. Use it to browse a known shop catalog. / 获取淘宝或天猫店铺的商品，使用卖家或用户ID和店铺ID，支持分页和按销量、新品、信用或价格排序。用于浏览已知店铺的商品目录。
  - Limitations and conditions: For some stores, the returned product list may be empty. / 对于某些店铺，返回的商品列表可能为空。
- [Shop Product List (V3) / 店铺商品列表 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/shop-product-list-v3): Retrieves products from a Taobao or Tmall shop by seller ID and shop ID with page-based pagination and configurable sorting, including a new-arrivals sort for discovering a shop's latest products. Use it to browse or monitor a known seller's catalog. / 通过卖家 ID 和店铺 ID 检索淘宝或天猫店铺的商品，支持分页浏览和可配置排序，包括新品排序，用于发现店铺的最新商品。可用于浏览或监控已知卖家的商品目录。
- [Shop Product List (V4) / 店铺商品列表 (V4)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/shop-product-list-v4): Retrieves products from a Taobao or Tmall shop by seller ID with page-based pagination. Use it to browse or monitor a known seller's catalog across result pages. / 通过卖家ID获取淘宝或天猫店铺的商品，支持基于页面的分页。用于跨结果页浏览或监控已知卖家的目录。
- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-search-v1): Searches Taobao and Tmall products by keyword with page, sort, optional Tmall-only, and inclusive price-range filters. Use it to discover products and narrow ecommerce research. / 通过关键词搜索淘宝和天猫商品，支持分页、排序、可选仅天猫和包含价格范围筛选。用于发现商品并缩小电商研究范围。
- [Product Search (V2) / 商品搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/taobao-and-tmall/product-search-v2): Searches Taobao and Tmall products by keyword with page-based pagination and returns results sorted by sales. Use it to discover popular products for ecommerce research, catalog analysis, or product selection. / 按关键词搜索淘宝和天猫商品，使用基于页码的分页方式，并返回按销量排序的结果。可用于发现热门商品，适用于电商研究、商品目录分析或选品。

### Xiaohongshu (RedNote) / 小红书

Xiaohongshu notes, comments, users, search, and link resolution for content monitoring and creator research. / 小红书笔记、评论、用户、搜索和链接解析，用于内容监控和创作者研究。

- [Ask Dots AI / 问点点AI](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/ask-dots-ai): Queries Xiaohongshu (RedNote) Ask Dots AI with a keyword question. Use it to retrieve an AI answer for topic research and question exploration. / 使用关键词问题查询小红书（RedNote）的问点点AI。用于检索 AI 答案，进行主题研究和问题探索。
- [Hot Search (V1) / 热搜 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/hot-search-v1): Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) hot-content entries with optional keyword, content-category path, pagination, ranking metric, and time-range controls. Use it to support trend discovery, topic monitoring, and content planning. / 搜索小红书 (RedNote) 热门内容条目，支持可选关键词、内容类目路径、分页、排序指标和时间范围控制。可用于趋势发现、话题监测和内容规划。
- [Hot Inspiration Feed (V1) / 热门灵感信息流 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/hot-inspiration-feed-v1): Retrieves the Xiaohongshu (RedNote) creator center hot inspiration feed with cursor pagination. Use it to discover inspiration for content planning and explore further pages of creative ideas. / 获取小红书（RedNote）创作者中心热门灵感信息流，支持游标分页。用于发现内容规划灵感并探索更多页的创意想法。
- [Keyword Note Search (V2) / 关键词笔记搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/note-search-v2): Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes by keyword with page-based pagination, sorting and note-type filters. The V2 noteTime filter may return notes outside the selected time range. This endpoint does not search user accounts. / 按关键词搜索小红书（RedNote）笔记，支持 page 分页、排序和笔记类型筛选。V2 的 noteTime 筛选可能返回所选时间范围之外的笔记。此接口不用于搜索用户账号。
- [Note Search (V4) / 笔记搜索 (V4)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/note-search-v4): Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes through the mobile-app search flow with pagination, sorting, note-type, and time filters. Use it to support iterative topic research and filtered content discovery. / 通过移动应用搜索流程搜索小红书（RedNote）笔记，支持分页、排序、笔记类型和时间筛选。用于支持迭代式主题研究和筛选内容发现。
- [User Search (V2) / 用户搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/user-search-v2): Searches Xiaohongshu (RedNote) users by keyword with page-based pagination. Use it to support creator discovery, account research, and finding profiles related to a topic, name, or brand term. / 通过关键词搜索小红书（RedNote）用户，支持基于页面的分页。用于支持创作者发现、账号研究以及查找与主题、名称或品牌词相关的个人资料。
- [User Notes (V4) / 用户笔记 (V4)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/user-published-notes-v4): Reads a user's published public Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes by user ID or supported profile URL, with lastCursor pagination. This endpoint does not create, upload or publish notes. / 通过用户 ID 或支持的个人主页 URL，读取小红书（RedNote）用户已发布的公开笔记，支持 lastCursor 分页。此接口不会创建、上传或发布笔记。
- [User Favorited Notes (V1) / 用户收藏的笔记 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/user-favorited-notes-v1): Retrieves a Xiaohongshu (RedNote) user's favorited notes by user ID with cursor pagination. Use it to review a user's saved content and research content interests. / 通过用户ID和游标分页获取小红书（RedNote）用户收藏的笔记。用于查看用户保存的内容和研究内容兴趣。
- [Note Details (V1) / 笔记详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/note-details-v1): Retrieves Xiaohongshu (RedNote) details for a note identified by a note ID or supported explore URL. Use it to perform direct note lookup and content review from stored identifiers or shared explore links. / 检索由笔记ID或受支持的探索URL标识的小红书（RedNote）笔记详情。用于从存储的标识符或共享的探索链接进行直接笔记查找和内容审查。
  - Limitations and conditions: This version does not support video downloads. / 此版本不支持视频下载。
- [Note Details (V6) / 笔记详情 (V6)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/note-details-v6): Retrieves Xiaohongshu (RedNote) video-note details by note ID. Use it to look up and process a known video note. / 根据笔记ID获取小红书（RedNote）视频笔记详情。用于查找和处理已知的视频笔记。
  - Limitations and conditions: This endpoint supports video downloads for video notes only; image-and-text notes are not supported. / 此接口仅支持视频笔记的视频下载；不支持图文笔记。
- [Note Comments (V2) / 笔记评论 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/note-comments-v2): Retrieves comments for a Xiaohongshu (RedNote) note with cursor pagination and normal, latest, or like-count sorting. Use it to support feedback review, discussion analysis, and comment moderation workflows. / 使用游标分页和普通、最新或点赞数排序，获取小红书（RedNote）笔记的评论。用于支持反馈审查、讨论分析和评论管理工作流。
- [Comment Replies (V2) / 评论回复 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/comment-replies-v2): Retrieves replies to a specific Xiaohongshu (RedNote) note comment with cursor pagination. Use it to inspect threaded discussions and continue through reply pages for feedback review or moderation. / 使用游标分页获取特定小红书（RedNote）笔记评论的回复。用于查看话题讨论并翻页浏览回复页面，以进行反馈审查或管理。
- [User Profile (V3) / 用户资料 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/user-profile-v3): Retrieves a Xiaohongshu (RedNote) user profile from a user ID or supported profile URL. Use it to support creator discovery, account research, and reviewing a known profile before related content analysis. / 通过用户ID或支持的个人主页URL获取小红书（RedNote）用户资料。用于支持创作者发现、账号研究，以及在进行相关内容分析前查看已知资料。
- [Keyword Suggestions (V1) / 关键词建议 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/keyword-suggestions-v1): Returns Xiaohongshu (RedNote) search keyword suggestions for a submitted seed term. Use it to expand query sets, refine content-research searches, and plan SEO or programmatic SEO keyword coverage. / 返回针对提交的种子词的小红书（RedNote）搜索关键词建议。用于扩展查询集、优化内容研究搜索，以及规划SEO或程序化SEO关键词覆盖。
- [Topic Note List (V1) / 话题笔记列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/topic-note-list-v1): Retrieves Xiaohongshu (RedNote) notes associated with a topic ID, with hot or latest sorting and cursor pagination. Use it to support topic content discovery, trend review, and continuing through topic result pages. / 使用热门或最新排序和游标分页，获取与话题ID相关的小红书（RedNote）笔记。用于支持话题内容发现、趋势回顾和翻页浏览话题结果页面。
- [Share Link Resolution (V1) / 分享链接解析 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-rednote/share-link-resolution-v1): Resolve a supported Xiaohongshu (RedNote) short share link and return its public redirect URL. Use it to expand shared links before subsequent Xiaohongshu content lookup or processing. / 解析受支持的小红书（RedNote）短分享链接并返回其公开重定向URL。用于在后续小红书内容查找或处理之前展开分享链接。

### Xiaohongshu E-commerce (RedNote) / 小红书电商

Xiaohongshu E-commerce product search for discovering marketplace products by keyword. / 小红书电商商品搜索，用于通过关键词发现市场商品。

- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-e-commerce-rednote/product-search-v1): Searches Xiaohongshu E-commerce (RedNote) products by keyword with page and search-ID pagination; pages after the first require the search ID returned by the initial search. Use it to discover marketplace products and continue through multi-page results. / 按关键词搜索小红书电商商品，使用分页和搜索ID分页；第一页之后的页面需要初始搜索返回的搜索ID。用于发现市场商品并翻页查看多页结果。

### Xiaohongshu Creator Marketplace (Pugongying) / 小红书蒲公英

Xiaohongshu creator marketplace profiles, audience insights, content performance, and campaign analytics. / 小红书蒲公英创作者市场资料、受众洞察、内容表现和活动分析。

- [Creator Search (V1) / 创作者搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-creator-marketplace-pugongying/creator-search-v1): Search Xiaohongshu Pugongying creators with campaign filters and sorting by followers, daily-note median reads or interactions, or quoted price. Use it to build a creator shortlist. / 使用营销活动筛选条件搜索小红书蒲公英创作者，支持按粉丝数、日常笔记阅读中位数、日常笔记互动中位数或报价排序。用于建立创作者候选名单。
- [Creator Profile (V1) / 创作者资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-creator-marketplace-pugongying/creator-profile-v1): Retrieve a Xiaohongshu Pugongying creator profile and cooperation quote information for a known user ID. Use it to review a creator before campaign outreach or pricing comparison. / 获取已知用户ID的小红书蒲公英创作者资料和合作报价信息。用于在活动对接或报价对比之前审查创作者。
- [Data Summary (V1) / 数据摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xiaohongshu-creator-marketplace-pugongying/data-summary-v1): Retrieve the Xiaohongshu Pugongying data summary for a creator's daily or cooperation notes. Use it to compare aggregate creator performance between business modes. / 获取创作者日常或合作笔记的小红书蒲公英数据摘要。用于比较不同业务模式下创作者的聚合表现。

### Douyin (TikTok China) / 抖音

Douyin user, video, comment, and search data for content intelligence, account monitoring, and discovery. / 抖音用户、视频、评论和搜索数据，用于内容情报、账号监控和发现。

- [Video Search (V4) / 视频搜索 (V4)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/video-search-v4): Searches Douyin (TikTok China) videos by keyword with sort, publish-time, duration, and page filters; later pages require the previous search ID. Use it to support content discovery and trend research. / 按关键词搜索抖音视频，支持排序、发布时间、时长和分页筛选；后续页面需要上一页的搜索ID。用于支持内容发现和趋势研究。
- [Image Post Search (V1) / 图片帖子搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/image-post-search-v1): Searches Douyin (TikTok China) image posts by keyword with search-session pagination. Omit searchId for the first page, then use the search ID from the previous response to continue. Use it for visual-content discovery and topic research. / 按关键词搜索抖音图片帖子，并使用搜索会话分页。第一页省略 searchId，之后使用上一次响应中的搜索 ID 继续。可用于视觉内容发现和话题研究。
- [Hot Search (V1) / 热搜 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/hot-search-v1): Searches Douyin (TikTok China) content with optional keyword, category, video-type, ranking, pagination, engagement, and creator-follower filters. Use it to support trend discovery and campaign research. / 搜索抖音内容，支持可选的关键词、类别、视频类型、排序、分页、互动量和创作者粉丝数筛选。用于支持趋势发现和活动研究。
- [User Search (V2) / 用户搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/user-search-v2): Searches Douyin (TikTok China) users by keyword with page-based pagination and optional account-type filtering. Use it to discover creators, brands, or verified accounts for research. / 按关键词搜索抖音用户，支持基于页面的分页和可选的账号类型筛选。用于发现创作者、品牌或认证账号进行研究。
- [User Published Videos (V1) / 用户发布视频 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/user-published-videos-v1): Retrieves videos published by a Douyin (TikTok China) user, with cursor pagination and newest or most-popular sorting. Use it to browse or monitor a creator's public video output. / 检索抖音用户发布的视频，支持游标分页以及最新或最热排序。用于浏览或监控创作者的公开视频输出。
- [User Published Videos (V3) / 用户发布视频 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/user-published-videos-v3): Retrieves videos published by a Douyin (TikTok China) user with cursor pagination. Use it to browse a known creator's public video history or continue through video pages. / 通过游标分页获取抖音用户发布的视频。用于浏览已知创作者的公开视频历史或翻看视频页面。
  - Limitations and conditions: For some users, their latest videos may not be accessible. / 对于某些用户，其最新视频可能无法访问。
- [Video Details (V2) / 视频详情 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/video-details-v2): Retrieves details for a Douyin (TikTok China) video by video ID. Use it to look up a known video before content review, archiving, or related analysis. / 通过视频ID获取抖音视频详情。用于在内容审核、存档或相关分析之前查找已知视频。
- [Video Comments (V1) / 视频评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/video-comments-v1): Retrieves top-level comments for a Douyin (TikTok China) video by aweme ID with page-based pagination. Use it to review audience feedback or analyze discussion around a known video. / 通过aweme ID以分页方式获取抖音视频的顶级评论。用于查看观众反馈或分析已知视频的讨论。
- [Comment Replies (V1) / 评论回复 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/comment-replies-v1): Retrieves replies to a top-level Douyin (TikTok China) video comment with page-based pagination. Use it to inspect threaded discussions and review feedback under a known comment. / 通过分页方式获取抖音视频顶级评论的回复。用于检查线索讨论并查看已知评论下的反馈。
- [User Profile (V3) / 用户资料 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/user-profile-v3): Retrieves a Douyin (TikTok China) user profile by secUid. Use it to review a known creator or account before monitoring related content or conducting account research. / 通过secUid获取抖音用户资料。用于在监控相关内容或进行账号研究之前查看已知创作者或账号。
- [Share Link Resolution (V1) / 分享链接解析 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douyin-tiktok-china/share-link-resolution-v1): Resolve a supported Douyin (TikTok China) short share link that targets a video and return its public redirect URL. Use it to expand video links before subsequent Douyin content lookup or processing. / 解析一个支持的抖音短分享链接（指向视频）并返回其公开重定向URL。用于在后续的抖音内容查找或处理之前展开视频链接。

### Kuaishou / 快手

Kuaishou user, video, comment, search, and link resolution data for account monitoring and content discovery. / 快手用户、视频、评论、搜索和链接解析数据，用于账号监控和内容发现。

- [Video Search (V1) / 视频搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/video-search-v1): Search public Kuaishou videos by keyword with cursor-based pagination. Use it to discover relevant videos and continue through additional result pages. / 通过关键词搜索快手公开视频，支持基于游标的分页。用于发现相关视频并继续浏览更多结果页。
- [Video Search (V2) / 视频搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/video-search-v2): Search public Kuaishou videos by keyword with page-number pagination. Use it to discover relevant videos and browse results by page. / 通过关键词搜索快手公开视频，支持页码分页。用于发现相关视频并按页浏览结果。
- [User Search (V2) / 用户搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/user-search-v2): Search public Kuaishou user accounts by keyword with page-number pagination. Use it to discover relevant creators or accounts before requesting profile and published-video data. / 通过关键词搜索快手公开用户账号，支持页码分页。用于在请求资料和发布视频数据前发现相关创作者或账号。
- [User Published Videos (V2) / 用户发布视频 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/user-published-videos-v2): Retrieve public videos published by a Kuaishou user, with optional cursor-based pagination. Use it to review a creator's content history or select videos for detail and comment requests. / 获取快手用户发布的公开视频，支持可选的基于游标的分页。用于查看创作者的视频历史或选择视频进行详细信息和评论请求。
- [Video Details (V2) / 视频详情 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/video-details-v2): Retrieve public details for a Kuaishou video identified by its video ID. Use it to inspect a selected video after search or user-published-video discovery. / 获取由视频ID标识的快手公开视频的详细信息。用于在经过搜索或用户发布视频发现后查看选定视频。
- [Video Comments (V1) / 视频评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/video-comments-v1): Retrieve public comments for a Kuaishou video, with optional cursor-based pagination. Use it to review audience discussion and continue through additional comment pages. / 获取快手视频的公开评论，支持基于游标的分页。用于查看观众讨论并继续浏览更多评论页面。
- [User Profile (V1) / 用户资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/user-profile-v1): Retrieve the public profile for a Kuaishou user identified by user ID. Use it to inspect an account found through user or video results. / 获取由用户ID标识的快手用户的公开资料。用于查看通过用户或视频结果发现的账号。
- [Share Link Resolution (V1) / 分享链接解析 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/kuaishou/share-link-resolution-v1): Resolve a supported Kuaishou short share link and return its public redirect URL. Use it to expand shared links before subsequent Kuaishou content lookup or processing. / 解析支持的快手短分享链接并返回其公开重定向URL。用于在后续快手内容查找或处理前展开分享链接。

### WeChat Official Accounts / 微信公众号

- [Account Principal Info (V1) / 账号主体信息 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-official-accounts/account-principal-info-v1): Retrieves principal information for a WeChat Official Account identified by biz ID, article URL, or wxid. - [Account Basic Info (V1) / 账户基本信息 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-official-accounts/account-basic-info-v1): Retrieves basic profile information for a WeChat Official Account by account name. - [Article Link Conversion (V1) / 文章链接转换 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-official-accounts/article-link-conversion-v1): Expands a WeChat Official Account article link to its resolved long-form destination. Use it to normalize a short or intermediate link before article lookup or collection. / 将微信公众号文章链接扩展为解析后的长链接。用于在文章查找或采集之前规范化短链接或中间链接。

### WeChat Channels / 微信视频号

WeChat Channels videos, creators, comments, search, and publisher content for media monitoring and discovery. / 微信视频号视频、创作者、评论、搜索和发布者内容，用于媒体监控和发现。

- [Video Search (V1) / 视频搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-search-v1): Searches WeChat Channels videos by keyword with publish-time, sort, page, offset, and continuation-state controls. Use it to find recent or ordered video results and continue web-search pages. / 按关键词搜索微信视频号视频，支持发布时间、排序、页码、偏移量和连续状态控制。用于查找最新或排序的视频结果，并继续网页搜索页面。
- [Video Search (V2) / 视频搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-search-v2): Searches the WeChat Channels video category by keyword with page, offset, and continuation-state controls. Use it to retrieve categorized video results and continue additional pages. / 按关键词搜索微信视频号的视频类别，支持页码、偏移量和连续状态控制。用于获取分类视频结果并继续加载更多页面。
- [Account Search (V1) / 账号搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/account-search-v1): Searches the WeChat Channels account category by keyword with page, offset, and continuation-state controls. Use it to discover creator accounts through paginated web-search results. / 按关键词搜索微信视频号的账号类别，支持页码、偏移量和连续状态控制。用于通过分页的网页搜索结果发现创作者账号。
- [Account Search (V2) / 账号搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/account-search-v2): Searches WeChat Channels account-related records by keyword using the direct Channels lookup. Use it to discover creator accounts and related channel objects without pagination input. / 通过直接视频号查询按关键词搜索微信视频号账号相关记录。用于发现创作者账号和相关频道对象，无需分页输入。
- [Account Search (V3) / 账号搜索 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/account-search-v3): Looks up a specific WeChat Channels account identity by keyword. Use it to resolve a creator name or account term to the identifier required by account-video queries. / 通过关键词查找特定的微信视频号账号身份。用于将创作者名称或账号术语解析为账号视频查询所需的标识符。
- [Account Videos (V1) / 账号视频 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/account-videos-v1): Retrieves a paginated WeChat Channels account feed by v2Name with continuation-buffer support. Use it to browse videos and other feed entries published by a known creator account. / 检索按v2Name分页的微信视频号账号动态，支持连续缓冲。用于浏览已知创作者账号发布的视频和其他动态条目。
- [Get Bound Channel (V1) / 获取绑定频道 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/get-bound-channel-v1): Finds the WeChat Channels account bound to a WeChat Official Account using either its original ID or an article URL. Use it to connect an official account with its Channels identity. / 使用其原始ID或文章URL，查找绑定到微信公众号的微信视频号账号。用于将公众号与其视频号身份关联起来。
- [Video Basic Info (V1) / 视频基本信息 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-basic-info-v1): Resolves a copied WeChat Channels video link, preview URL, or short feed ID to basic video information. Use it to identify a shared Channels video before further lookups. / 解析复制的微信视频号视频链接、预览URL或短动态ID，以获取基本视频信息。用于在进行进一步查询之前识别分享的微信视频号视频。
- [Video Title (V1) / 视频标题 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-title-v1): Retrieves lightweight title information for a WeChat Channels video by object ID and optional nonce ID. Use it to identify known video content without requesting downloadable media. / 通过对象ID和可选随机数ID检索微信视频号视频的轻量级标题信息。用于在不请求可下载媒体的情况下识别已知视频内容。
  - Limitations and conditions: This endpoint does not return downloadable media links. / 此接口不返回可下载的媒体链接。
- [Export Id Conversion (V1) / 导出 ID 转换 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/export-id-conversion-v1): Converts an encrypted WeChat Channels export ID from search results into a usable video object identity. Use it to prepare the identifier required by video lookup endpoints. / 将搜索结果中的加密微信视频号导出ID转换为可用的视频对象标识。用于准备视频查询接口所需的标识符。
- [Video Download URL (V1) / 视频下载链接 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-download-url-v1): Retrieves a downloadable media URL for a WeChat Channels video by object ID and optional nonce ID. Use it to download or play media from a known Channels video. / 通过对象ID和可选随机数ID检索微信视频号视频的可下载媒体URL。用于从已知视频号视频下载或播放媒体。
- [Video Share URL (V1) / 视频分享链接 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-share-url-v1): Generates a share link for a WeChat Channels video identified by objectId. Use it to share a known Channels video or obtain its link for a subsequent lookup. / 为通过 objectId 标识的微信视频号视频生成分享链接。用于分享已知的视频号视频，或获取其链接以供后续查询。
- [Video Metrics (V1) / 视频指标 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-metrics-v1): Retrieves interaction metrics for a WeChat Channels video by object ID with optional continuation-buffer input. Use it to review engagement for known video content. / 通过对象ID和可选的连续缓冲输入检索微信视频号视频的互动指标。用于查看已知视频内容的参与度。
- [Video Comments (V1) / 视频评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-comments-v1): Retrieves first-level comments for a WeChat Channels video by object ID with continuation-buffer pagination. Use it to review audience discussion on known video content. / 通过对象ID和连续缓冲分页检索微信视频号视频的一级评论。用于查看已知视频内容的观众讨论。
- [Video Sub Comments (V1) / 视频子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/wechat-channels/video-sub-comments-v1): Retrieves replies under a first-level WeChat Channels video comment using the video and root-comment IDs. Use it to continue a threaded comment discussion with buffer pagination. / 使用视频和根评论ID检索微信视频号视频一级评论下的回复。用于通过缓冲分页继续线程化的评论讨论。

### QQ Huxuan Creator Marketplace / 腾讯互选

Tencent creator marketplace search, profiles, recent videos, and articles for campaign planning and creator evaluation. / 腾讯创作者市场搜索、资料、近期视频和文章，用于活动策划和创作者评估。

- [Video Account Creator Search (V1) / 视频号达人搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/video-account-creator-search-v1): Searches or browses QQ Huxuan Video Account creators by optional nickname keyword with page-number pagination. Use it to discover and shortlist video creators for Tencent Huxuan campaign planning. / 通过可选昵称关键词和页码分页搜索或浏览QQ互选视频号创作者。用于发现和筛选视频创作者，以进行腾讯互选广告策划。
- [Official Account Creator Search (V1) / 公众号达人搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/official-account-creator-search-v1): Searches or browses QQ Huxuan Official Account creators by optional nickname or account keyword with page-number pagination. Use it to discover and shortlist publishers for Tencent Huxuan campaign planning. / 通过可选昵称或账号关键词和页码分页搜索或浏览QQ互选公众号创作者。用于发现和筛选发布者，以进行腾讯互选广告策划。
- [Video Account Creator Details (V1) / 视频号达人详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/video-account-creator-details-v1): Retrieves QQ Huxuan Video Account creator details for a known creator app ID. Use it to review a shortlisted video creator before Tencent Huxuan campaign selection. / 检索已知创作者应用ID的QQ互选视频号创作者详细信息。用于在腾讯互选广告选择之前审查已入围的视频创作者。
- [Video Account Recent Videos (V1) / 视频号近期视频 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/video-account-recent-videos-v1): Lists videos from a QQ Huxuan Video Account creator within a required date range, with a choice of all, Huxuan order, hot, or personal videos. Use it to review a shortlisted creator's content for campaign planning. / 列出QQ互选视频号创作者在所需日期范围内的视频，可选择所有视频、互选订单视频、热门视频或个人视频。用于审查已入围创作者的内容，以进行广告策划。
- [Official Account Creator Details (V1) / 公众号达人详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/official-account-creator-details-v1): Retrieves QQ Huxuan Official Account creator details for a known creator app ID. Use it to review a shortlisted publisher before Tencent Huxuan campaign selection. / 检索已知创作者应用ID的QQ互选公众号创作者详细信息。用于在腾讯互选广告选择之前审查已入围的发布者。
- [Official Account Article List (V1) / 公众号文章列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/official-account-article-list-v1): Lists articles from a QQ Huxuan Official Account creator within a required date range, with an optional title keyword and a choice between all articles and Huxuan order articles. Use it to review a publisher's content for campaign planning. / 列出QQ互选公众号创作者在所需日期范围内的文章，可选标题关键词，并可在所有文章和互选订单文章之间选择。用于审查发布者的内容，以进行广告策划。
- [Hot Content Trends (V1) / 热门内容趋势 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/qq-huxuan-creator-marketplace/hot-content-trends-v1): Lists QQ Huxuan hot Video Account content by month and creator category, with six descending sort metrics and page-number pagination. Use it to research monthly content trends for Tencent Huxuan campaign planning. / 按月份和创作者类别列出QQ互选热门视频号内容，提供六种降序排序指标和页码分页。用于研究腾讯互选活动策划的月度内容趋势。

### Weibo / 微博

Weibo posts, comments, hot search rankings, account details, and follower data for social listening and research. / 微博帖子、评论、热搜排名、账号详情和粉丝数据，用于社交监听和研究。

- [Keyword Search (V2) / 关键词搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/keyword-search-v2): Searches Weibo posts by keyword within a required day-and-hour time range, with page-based pagination, hot or time sorting, and filters for pictures, video, music, or links. Use it to find time-bounded posts for topic research or monitoring. / 通过关键词在所需的小时日时间范围内搜索微博帖子，支持基于页码的分页、热门或时间排序，以及图片、视频、音乐或链接的筛选。用于查找有时间限制的帖子，以进行话题研究或监控。
- [Post Details (V1) / 帖子详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/post-details-v1): Retrieves details for a Weibo post identified by its post ID. Use it to look up a known post for content review, archiving, or related engagement analysis. / 检索通过帖子ID标识的微博帖子详情。用于查找已知帖子，以进行内容审查、存档或相关互动分析。
- [User Profile (V3) / 用户资料 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/user-profile-v3): Retrieves a Weibo user profile identified by UID. Use it to look up a known account for creator research, profile review, or subsequent retrieval of that user's posts and videos. / 检索通过UID标识的微博用户资料。用于查找已知账号，以进行创作者研究、资料审查或后续检索该用户的帖子和视频。
- [User Fans (V1) / 用户粉丝 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/user-fans-v1): Retrieves a page of fan accounts that follow a Weibo user identified by UID. Use it to browse the account's follower audience or continue through its fan list. / 检索由UID标识的微博用户的粉丝账号页面。用于浏览该账号的粉丝受众或继续翻阅粉丝列表。
- [User Followers (V1) / 用户关注者 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/user-followers-v1): Retrieves a page of accounts followed by a Weibo user identified by UID. Use it to examine the account's outgoing follow network or continue through its following list. / 检索由UID标识的微博用户关注的账号页面。用于检查该账号的关注网络或继续翻阅关注列表。
- [User Published Posts (V1) / 用户发布帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/user-published-posts-v1): Retrieves posts published by a Weibo user identified by UID, using page numbers and a required sinceId cursor after the first page. Use it to browse an account's posting history or continue through its post feed. / 检索由UID标识的微博用户发布的帖子，使用页码和第一页后必需的sinceId游标。用于浏览账号的发布历史或继续翻阅帖子feed。
- [User Video List (V1) / 用户视频列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/user-video-list-v1): Retrieves a Weibo user's video waterfall feed by UID, with an optional cursor from a prior response. Use it to browse videos published by a known account or continue through its video feed. / 检索由UID标识的微博用户的视频瀑布流，可使用先前响应中的可选游标。用于浏览已知账号发布的视频或继续翻阅视频feed。
- [TV Video Details (V1) / 电视视频详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/tv-video-details-v1): Retrieves Weibo TV video details for a colon-delimited object ID (OID). Use it to look up a known TV video for content review, cataloging, or downstream processing. / 检索由冒号分隔的对象ID (OID) 标识的微博TV视频详情。用于查找已知的TV视频以进行内容审核、编目或后续处理。
- [Hot Search (V1) / 热搜 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/hot-search-v1): Retrieves the current Weibo hot-search ranking. Use it to identify trending topics for newsroom monitoring, content planning, or timely topic discovery. / 检索当前的微博热搜排名。用于识别热门话题以进行新闻监测、内容规划或及时话题发现。
- [Post Comments (V1) / 帖子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/post-comments-v1): Retrieves comments for a Weibo post identified by MID, with optional maxId cursor pagination and time or hot sorting. Use it to review audience discussion, continue through comment pages, or support moderation and feedback analysis. / 检索由MID标识的微博帖子的评论，支持可选的maxId游标分页以及时间或热度排序。用于查看受众讨论、继续翻阅评论区或支持审核和反馈分析。
- [Search User Published Posts (V1) / 搜索用户发布帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/weibo/search-user-published-posts-v1): Searches posts published by a specific Weibo user, using a keyword, optional date range, and page-based pagination. Use it to find historical posts from a known account for topic research or campaign review. / 搜索特定微博用户发布的帖子，使用关键词、可选的日期范围和基于页面的分页。用于从已知账号查找历史帖子以进行话题研究或活动回顾。

### Bilibili / 哔哩哔哩

Bilibili video metadata, comments, danmaku, captions, users, and uploads for media analysis and discovery. / 哔哩哔哩视频元数据、评论、弹幕、字幕、用户和上传，用于媒体分析和发现。

- [Video Details (V2) / 视频详情 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/video-details-v2): Retrieves details for a Bilibili video identified by its BVID. Use it to look up a known video for content review, cataloging, or subsequent engagement analysis. / 检索由BVID标识的哔哩哔哩视频详情。用于查找已知视频以进行内容审核、编目或后续互动分析。
- [User Published Videos (V2) / 用户发布视频 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/user-published-videos-v2): Retrieves videos published by a Bilibili user identified by UID, with an optional continuation parameter from a prior response. Use it to browse a creator's uploads or continue through their video list. / 检索由UID标识的哔哩哔哩用户发布的视频，可使用先前响应中的可选继续参数。用于浏览创作者的视频内容或继续翻阅其视频列表。
- [User Profile (V2) / 用户资料 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/user-profile-v2): Retrieves a Bilibili user profile identified by UID. Use it to look up a known account for creator research, profile review, or subsequent retrieval of that user's videos. / 检索由UID标识的哔哩哔哩用户资料。用于查找已知账号以进行创作者研究、资料审核或后续获取该用户的视频。
- [Video Danmaku (V2) / 视频弹幕 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/video-danmaku-v2): Retrieves one page of danmaku comments for a Bilibili video segment identified by AID and CID. Use it to review time-synchronized audience reactions or page through danmaku for a known video. / 检索由AID和CID标识的哔哩哔哩视频片段的单页弹幕评论。用于查看时间同步的受众反应或为已知视频翻页弹幕。
- [Video Comments (V2) / 视频评论 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/video-comments-v2): Retrieves comments for a Bilibili video identified by AID, with optional cursor pagination. Use it to review audience discussion, continue through comment pages, or support comment moderation and analysis. / 检索由AID标识的哔哩哔哩视频的评论，支持可选的游标分页。用于查看受众讨论、继续翻阅评论页或支持评论审核和分析。
- [Video Search (V2) / 视频搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/video-search-v2): Searches Bilibili videos by keyword with page-based pagination and sorting by general ranking, play count, publish time, danmaku count, or favorites. Use it to support content discovery, topic research, or ranking-focused searches. / 按关键词搜索哔哩哔哩视频，支持基于页面的分页，并可按照综合排名、播放量、发布时间、弹幕数或收藏数排序。用于支持内容发现、话题研究或排名导向的搜索。
- [Share Link Resolution (V1) / 分享链接解析 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/share-link-resolution-v1): Resolve a supported Bilibili short share link that targets a video and return its public redirect URL. Use it to expand video links before subsequent Bilibili content lookup or processing. / 解析指向视频的受支持哔哩哔哩短分享链接，并返回其公共重定向URL。用于在后续哔哩哔哩内容查找或处理之前展开视频链接。
  - Limitations and conditions: Video Links Only: This endpoint does not support share links that resolve to non-video destinations. / 仅限视频链接: 此接口不支持解析到非视频目的地的分享链接。
- [User Relation Stats (V1) / 用户关系统计 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/user-relation-stats-v1): Retrieves relation statistics for a Bilibili user identified by WMID. Use it to compare audience relationships across creator accounts or track relation-count changes for a known user. / 检索由WMID标识的哔哩哔哩用户的关系统计。用于比较不同创作者账号的受众关系或跟踪已知用户的关系数量变化。
- [Video Captions (V2) / 视频字幕 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/bilibili/video-captions-v2): Retrieves caption data for a Bilibili video segment identified by BVID, AID, and CID. Use it to obtain subtitles for transcript extraction, accessibility review, or language-focused content analysis. / 检索由BVID、AID和CID标识的哔哩哔哩视频片段的字幕数据。用于获取字幕以进行转录提取、无障碍审核或面向语言的内容分析。

- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/dewu-poizon/product-search-v1): Searches Dewu (Poizon) products by keyword with page-based pagination. Use it to discover marketplace products matching a title or product term. / 通过关键词搜索得物商品，支持分页。用于发现与标题或产品词匹配的市场商品。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃

### JD.com / 京东

JD.com product details, reviews, and store catalog data for commerce intelligence and catalog monitoring. / 京东商品详情、评价和店铺目录数据，用于商业情报和目录监控。

- [Product Details (V1) / 商品详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-details-v1): Retrieve JD.com product details for a known item ID. Use it to inspect an individual product after finding its identifier. / 通过已知商品ID获取京东商品详情。用于在找到其标识符后查看单个商品。
  - Limitations and conditions: Description images: A dedicated description-image list and description HTML may be absent. Use V3 for this content. / 描述图片: 专用的描述图片列表和描述 HTML 可能缺失。请使用 V3 获取此内容。
- [Product Details (V3) / 商品详情 (V3)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-details-v3): Retrieve JD.com product details by item ID. Use it to review product information and description images for catalog research or product displays. / 通过商品 ID 获取京东商品详情。使用它来查看商品信息和描述图片，用于目录研究或商品展示。
- [Product Details (V4) / 商品详情 (V4)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-details-v4): Retrieve JD.com product details by item ID. Use it to review product information and images for catalog research or ecommerce analysis. / 通过商品 ID 获取京东商品详情。可用于查看商品信息和图片，以进行商品目录研究或电商分析。
  - Limitations and conditions: Description images: img_list may mix main images with some description or illustration images. Use V3 for a separate, more complete description-image list. / 描述图片: img_list 可能将主图与一些描述图或示意图混在一起。使用 V3 获取单独、更完整的描述图片列表。
- [Product Description Images (V1) / 商品描述图片 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-description-images-v1): Retrieve JD.com product description images and product attributes by item ID. Use it to review product introductions for catalog research and product presentation. / 通过 item ID 获取 JD.com 商品描述图片和商品属性。用于查看商品介绍，进行目录研究和商品展示。
- [Product Price (V1) / 商品价格 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-price-v1): Retrieve the current JD.com product price for a known item ID. Use it to check a product's price before catalog comparison or purchase analysis. / 通过已知商品ID获取京东商品当前价格。用于在目录比较或购买分析前检查商品价格。
- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-search-v1): Search JD.com products by keyword with page-based pagination. Use it to discover products and collect item IDs for follow-up lookups. / 通过关键词搜索京东商品，支持分页。用于发现商品并收集商品ID以供后续查询。
- [Product Comments (V1) / 商品评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-comments-v1): Retrieve paginated customer comments for a JD.com product identified by item ID. Use it to review buyer feedback for a known product. / 获取按商品ID标识的京东商品的分页买家评论。用于查看已知商品的买家反馈。
- [Product Comments (V2) / 商品评论 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/product-comments-v2): Retrieve paginated JD.com product comments for a specific SKU. Use it to review buyer feedback for that product. / 获取指定SKU的京东商品分页评论。用于查看该商品的买家反馈。
- [Shop Product List (V1) / 店铺商品列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/jdcom/shop-product-list-v1): Retrieve a page of products from a JD.com shop identified by shop ID. Use it to browse a seller's catalog and collect item IDs for follow-up lookups. / 获取按店铺ID标识的京东店铺的一页商品。用于浏览卖家目录并收集商品ID以供后续查询。

### Xianyu (GooFish) / 闲鱼

Xianyu second-hand marketplace listings and details for resale research, seller analysis, and price monitoring. / 闲鱼二手市场列表和详情，用于转售研究、卖家分析和价格监控。

- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xianyu-goofish/product-search-v1): Searches Xianyu (GooFish) second-hand listings by keyword with page and sort controls. Use it to discover resale items by activity, recency, seller credit, price, or listing time. / 通过关键词搜索闲鱼二手商品，支持分页和排序控制。用于按活跃度、最新发布、卖家信用、价格或发布时间发现转售商品。
- [Product Details (V1) / 商品详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/xianyu-goofish/product-details-v1): Retrieves the public detail for a Xianyu (GooFish) second-hand listing by item ID. Use it to inspect a known resale item after search or link discovery. / 通过商品ID获取闲鱼二手商品的公开详情。用于在搜索或链接发现后检查已知转售商品。

### AliExpress / AliExpress

AliExpress marketplace product search and product detail data for commerce research and catalog analysis. / AliExpress 市场商品搜索与商品详情数据，用于商业研究和目录分析。

- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/aliexpress/product-search-v1): Searches AliExpress products with optional query, page, sort, category, brand, location, attribute, price, locale, region, and currency controls. Use it for product discovery, catalog research, and marketplace assortment analysis. / 使用可选的查询词、页码、排序、类别、品牌、位置、属性、价格、语言环境、地区和货币控制来搜索 AliExpress 商品。用于商品发现、目录研究和市场品类分析。
- [Product Overview (V1) / 商品概览 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/aliexpress/product-overview-v1): Retrieves an AliExpress product overview by item ID for the United States or global site. Use it to inspect a known listing for catalog review or search snippets. / 通过商品ID获取美国或全球站点上的AliExpress商品概览。用于检查已知商品列表，以便进行目录审查或搜索摘要。

### Shopee / Shopee

Shopee marketplace product, shop, review, search, and category data across Taiwan, Indonesia, and Thailand, with installment data where supported. / Shopee 电商平台商品、店铺、评论、搜索和分类数据，覆盖台湾、印度尼西亚和泰国，支持分期数据（如有）。

- [Item Details (V1) / 商品详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-details-v1): Retrieves Shopee item details by marketplace site and item ID. / 通过市场站点和商品 ID 获取 Shopee 商品详情。
- [Shop Profile and Rating Summary (V1) / 店铺资料和评分摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/shop-profile-and-rating-summary-v1): Retrieves a Shopee shop profile and rating summary by marketplace site and shop ID. / 通过市场站点和店铺 ID 获取 Shopee 店铺资料和评分摘要。
- [Item Details (V2) / 商品详情 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-details-v2): Retrieves Shopee item details by marketplace site, shop ID, and item ID using the version 2 data source. / 使用版本 2 数据源，通过市场站点、店铺 ID 和商品 ID 获取 Shopee 商品详情。
- [Shop Item List (V1) / 店铺商品列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/shop-item-list-v1): Retrieves Shopee item cards for a shop username in the selected marketplace site. / 通过所选市场站点中的店铺用户名获取 Shopee 商品卡片。
- [Item SKU Matrix (V1) / 商品 SKU 矩阵 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-sku-matrix-v1): Retrieves the SKU option matrix for a Shopee item in the selected marketplace site. / 获取所选市场站点中 Shopee 商品的 SKU 选项矩阵。
- [Shop Basic Profile (V1) / 店铺基本资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/shop-basic-profile-v1): Retrieves the basic Shopee shop profile by username and marketplace site. / 通过用户名和市场站点获取 Shopee 店铺基本资料。
- [Item Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-search-v1): Searches Shopee items by keyword in the selected marketplace site. / 在所选市场站点中按关键词搜索 Shopee 商品。
- [Item SKU Models (V1) / 商品 SKU 模型 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-sku-models-v1): Retrieves observed SKU models for a Shopee item with offset and rating filters. / 检索 Shopee 商品的 SKU 模型，提供偏移量和评分筛选。
- [Shop Details (V1) / 店铺详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/shop-details-v1): Retrieves detailed Shopee shop information by username and marketplace site. / 根据用户名和市场站点检索详细的 Shopee 店铺信息。
- [Rich Shop Reviews (V1) / 详细的店铺评价 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/rich-shop-reviews-v1): Retrieves enriched Shopee shop reviews using a zero-based result offset. / 使用从零开始的结果偏移量检索详细的 Shopee 店铺评价。
- [Item Display Snapshot (V1) / 商品展示快照 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-display-snapshot-v1): Retrieves a display snapshot for a Shopee item in the selected marketplace site. / 检索所选市场站点中 Shopee 商品的展示快照。
- [Shop Reviews (V1) / 店铺评价 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/shop-reviews-v1): Retrieves Shopee shop reviews with offset pagination and a rating filter. / 检索 Shopee 店铺评价，提供偏移分页和评分筛选。
- [Item Reviews (V1) / 商品评价 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-reviews-v1): Retrieves reviews for a specified Shopee item with offset pagination and a rating filter. / 检索指定 Shopee 商品的评价，提供偏移分页和评分筛选。
- [Shop Categories (V1) / 店铺分类 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/shop-categories-v1): Retrieves Shopee shop categories using a zero-based result offset. / 使用从零开始的结果偏移量检索 Shopee 店铺分类。
- [Item Review Model Distribution (V1) / 商品评价模型分布 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-review-model-distribution-v1): Retrieves the review distribution across SKU models for a Shopee item. / 获取Shopee商品在SKU模型上的评价分布。
- [Item Review Tags (V1) / 商品评价标签 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-review-tags-v1): Retrieves review tags for a Shopee item in the selected marketplace site. / 获取指定市场站点中Shopee商品的评价标签。
- [Search Category Facets (V1) / 搜索分类面 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/search-category-facets-v1): Retrieves category facets for a Shopee product search keyword. / 获取Shopee商品搜索关键词的分类面。
- [Item Installments and Amounts (V1) / 商品分期与金额 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/shopee/item-installments-and-amounts-v1): Retrieves installment and amount information for a Shopee item. This operation supports Taiwan and Indonesia but not Thailand. / 获取Shopee商品的分期和金额信息。此操作支持台湾和印度尼西亚，但不支持泰国。

Douban Movie titles, reviews, comments, and hot lists for entertainment analysis and catalog enrichment. / 豆瓣电影标题、评价、评论和热门列表，用于娱乐分析和目录丰富。

- [Movie Reviews (V1) / 影评 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douban-movie/movie-reviews-v1): Retrieves paginated Douban long-form reviews for a movie or TV subject, ordered by time or popularity. Use it to browse in-depth audience reviews for a known subject. / 获取豆瓣电影或电视剧目的分页长评，按时间或热度排序。用于浏览已知剧目的深度观众评论。
- [Review Details (V1) / 评价详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douban-movie/review-details-v1): Retrieves a single Douban long-form review by its review ID. Use it to inspect a known review after discovering it in a subject's review list. / 通过评论ID获取单条豆瓣长评。用于在剧目的评论列表中发现后检查已知评论。
- [Subject Details (V1) / 条目详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douban-movie/subject-details-v1): Retrieves the public detail page data for a Douban movie or TV subject by subject ID. Use it to inspect a known title before requesting its reviews or comments. / 通过剧目ID获取豆瓣电影或电视剧目的公开详情页数据。用于在请求其评论或短评前检查已知剧目。
- [Comments (V1) / 评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douban-movie/comments-v1): Retrieves paginated Douban short comments for a movie or TV subject, ordered by time or newest rating. Use it to review concise audience feedback for a known subject. / 获取豆瓣电影或电视剧目的分页短评，按时间或最新评分排序。用于查看已知剧目的简洁观众反馈。
- [Recent Hot Movie (V1) / 近期热门电影 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douban-movie/recent-hot-movie-v1): Retrieves a paginated list of movies currently featured in Douban's recent-hot collection. Use it to discover popular movie titles and continue through result pages. / 获取豆瓣近期热门合集中当前展示的电影分页列表。使用该接口发现热门电影标题，并继续浏览结果页面。
- [Recent Hot Tv (V1) / 近期热门电视剧 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/douban-movie/recent-hot-tv-v1): Retrieves a paginated list of TV titles currently featured in Douban's recent-hot collection. Use it to discover popular series and continue through result pages. / 获取豆瓣近期热门合集中当前展示的电视剧分页列表。使用该接口发现热门剧集，并继续浏览结果页面。

### TikTok / TikTok

TikTok users, posts, comments, and search data for global short-video monitoring and creator research. / TikTok用户、帖子、评论和搜索数据，用于全球短视频监控和创作者研究。

- [User Published Posts (V1) / 用户发布帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/tiktok/user-published-posts-v1): Retrieves posts published by a TikTok user identified by secUid, with cursor pagination and latest or popular sorting. Use it to browse a creator's posting history or continue through their public post feed. / 获取由 secUid 标识的 TikTok 用户发布的帖子，提供游标分页和最新或最热门排序。使用该接口浏览创作者的发布历史或继续浏览其公开帖子流。
- [Post Details (V1) / 帖子详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/tiktok/post-details-v1): Retrieves details for a TikTok post identified by its post ID. Use it to look up a known TikTok video before content review, reporting, or related engagement analysis. / 获取由帖子 ID 标识的 TikTok 帖子详情。使用该接口在进行内容审核、举报或相关互动分析之前查找已知的 TikTok 视频。
- [User Profile (V1) / 用户资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/tiktok/user-profile-v1): Retrieves a TikTok user profile by public username or secUid. Use it to look up a known account for creator research, profile review, or subsequent user-post retrieval. / 通过公开用户名或 secUid 获取 TikTok 用户资料。使用该接口查找已知账号进行创作者研究、资料审核或后续用户帖子获取。
- [Post Comments (V1) / 帖子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/tiktok/post-comments-v1): Retrieves comments for a TikTok post with cursor pagination. Use it to review audience discussion, continue through comment pages, or support comment analysis for a known post. / 获取 TikTok 帖子的评论，提供游标分页。使用该接口审查受众讨论、继续浏览评论页面，或支持对已知帖子的评论分析。
- [Comment Replies (V1) / 评论回复 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/tiktok/comment-replies-v1): Retrieves replies to a specific comment on a TikTok post with cursor pagination. Use it to inspect threaded discussions and continue through reply pages for a known post comment. / 获取 TikTok 帖子上特定评论的回复，提供游标分页。使用该接口检查层级讨论，并继续浏览已知帖子评论的回复页面。
- [Post Search (V1) / 作品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/tiktok/post-search-v1): Searches TikTok posts by keyword with offset pagination plus sorting, publish-time, and region controls. Use it to support regional content discovery, topic research, or monitoring keyword-related videos. / 通过关键词搜索 TikTok 帖子，提供偏移分页、排序、发布时间和区域控制。使用该接口支持区域内容发现、主题研究或监控与关键词相关的视频。

- [Post Details (V1) / 帖子详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/post-details-v1): Retrieves an Instagram post by its shortcode. Use it to look up a known post before content review, archiving, comment analysis, or related workflows. / 通过短代码获取Instagram帖子。用于在内容审核、归档、评论分析或相关工作流程之前查找已知帖子。
- [User Published Posts (V1) / 用户发布帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/user-published-posts-v1): Retrieves posts published by an Instagram user with token-based pagination. Use it to browse a known account's post history or continue through subsequent result pages. / 通过基于Token的分页获取Instagram用户发布的帖子。用于浏览已知账户的帖子历史记录或继续浏览后续结果页面。
- [General Search (V1) / 通用搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/general-search-v1): Performs a general search on Instagram by keyword with token-based pagination. Use it to discover matching results, research topics, and continue through subsequent result pages. / 通过关键词在 Instagram 上执行通用搜索，使用基于令牌的分页。用于发现匹配结果、研究主题，并继续浏览后续结果页。
- [Reels Search (V1) / Reels 搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/reels-search-v1): Searches Instagram Reels by keyword or hashtag with token-based pagination. Use it to discover short-form videos, monitor topics, and continue through matching results. / 通过关键词或话题标签搜索Instagram Reels，支持基于Token的分页。用于发现短视频、监控话题并继续浏览匹配结果。
- [Hashtag Posts Search (V1) / 话题标签帖子搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/hashtag-posts-search-v1): Searches Instagram posts by hashtag with cursor pagination. Use it to explore tagged content, monitor topics, and continue through subsequent result pages. / 通过话题标签搜索Instagram帖子，使用游标分页。用于探索带标签的内容、监控话题并继续浏览后续结果页面。
- [Post Comment List (V1) / 帖子评论列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/post-comment-list-v1): Retrieves top-level comments for an Instagram post by shortcode, with cursor pagination and popular or newest sorting. Use it to review audience feedback or analyze discussion around a known post. / 通过短代码获取Instagram帖子的顶级评论，支持游标分页以及按热门或最新排序。用于查看观众反馈或分析已知帖子周围的讨论。
- [Comment Reply List (V1) / 评论回复列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/instagram/comment-reply-list-v1): Retrieves replies to a specific Instagram post comment by media and comment IDs, with cursor pagination. Use it to inspect threaded discussion and continue through reply pages. / 通过媒体ID和评论ID获取特定Instagram帖子评论的回复，支持游标分页。用于检查分层讨论并继续浏览回复页面。

### YouTube / YouTube

YouTube channel uploads and video details for content indexing, creator monitoring, and media analysis. / YouTube频道上传和视频详情，用于内容索引、创作者监控和媒体分析。

- [General Search (V1) / 通用搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/general-search-v1): Search YouTube videos by keyword with optional language, upload-date, duration, and sort filters, or continue with a pagination token. Use it to discover public videos or browse additional result pages. / 按关键词搜索YouTube视频，支持可选的语言、上传日期、时长和排序筛选条件，或使用分页令牌继续浏览。可用于发现公开视频或浏览更多结果页。
- [Video Details (V1) / 视频详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/video-details-v1): Retrieve public details for a YouTube video identified by video ID. Use it to inspect a known video before further content or comment analysis. / 通过视频ID获取YouTube视频的公开详情。用于在进一步内容或评论分析之前检查已知视频。
- [Channel Videos (V1) / 频道视频 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/channel-videos-v1): Retrieve public videos from a YouTube channel, with optional cursor-based pagination. Use it to browse a channel's uploads and continue through additional result pages. / 从YouTube频道获取公开视频，可选基于游标的分页。用于浏览频道的上传内容并继续浏览其他结果页面。
- [Video Captions (V1) / 视频字幕 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/video-captions-v1): Retrieve available caption tracks for a YouTube video or request captions in SRT, XML, JSON3, or plain-text format. Use it to support transcription, accessibility, localization, or text analysis. / 获取YouTube视频的可用字幕轨道，或以SRT、XML、JSON3或纯文本格式请求字幕。用于支持转录、无障碍访问、本地化或文本分析。
- [Channel Shorts (V1) / 频道 Shorts (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/channel-shorts-v1): Retrieve public Shorts from a YouTube channel ID with optional continuation-token pagination. Use it to browse a channel's short-form videos and continue through additional result pages. / 通过YouTube频道ID检索公开的Shorts，支持可选的continuation-token分页。用于浏览频道的短视频并继续加载更多结果页。
- [Video Comment List (V1) / 视频评论列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/video-comment-list-v1): Retrieve first-level comments for a YouTube video with sorting, locale options, and cursor pagination. Use it to review audience discussion or continue through additional comment pages. / 获取YouTube视频的一级评论，支持排序、区域设置选项和游标分页。用于查看观众讨论或继续浏览其他评论页面。
- [Video Sub Comment List (V1) / 视频子评论列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/youtube/video-sub-comment-list-v1): Retrieve replies associated with a YouTube comment continuation cursor, with optional locale settings. Use it to follow threaded discussion beyond first-level comments. / 获取与YouTube评论延续游标关联的回复，可选区域设置。用于跟踪一级评论之外的分层讨论。

### Reddit / Reddit

Reddit search, posts, and comments for community monitoring and discussion analysis. / Reddit搜索、帖子和评论，用于社区监控和讨论分析。

- [Post Details (V1) / 帖子详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/reddit/post-details-v1): Retrieves details for a Reddit post identified by its full post ID. Use it to look up a known post before discussion review, content analysis, or subsequent comment retrieval. / 通过完整帖子ID获取Reddit帖子的详情。用于在讨论审查、内容分析或后续评论获取之前查找已知帖子。
- [Post Comments (V1) / 帖子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/reddit/post-comments-v1): Retrieves comments for a Reddit post with pagination-token support. Use it to review a thread's discussion or continue through additional comment results for a known post. / 获取Reddit帖子的评论，支持分页令牌。用于审查帖子的讨论或继续查看已知帖子的其他评论结果。
- [Keyword Search (V1) / 关键词搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/reddit/keyword-search-v1): Searches Reddit posts by keyword with an optional continuation token. Use it to discover topic-related discussions or continue through additional search-result pages. / 通过关键词搜索Reddit帖子，可选延续令牌。用于发现与主题相关的讨论或继续浏览其他搜索结果页面。

### Toutiao / 今日头条

Toutiao articles, videos, profiles, and search data for news monitoring, publisher analysis, and topic research. / 今日头条文章、视频、主页资料和搜索数据，用于新闻监测、发布者分析和话题研究。

- [Article Details (V1) / 文章详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/toutiao/article-details-v1): Retrieves details for a Toutiao article identified by its article ID. Use it to look up a known article for content review, archiving, or related media analysis. / 通过文章ID获取今日头条文章的详情。用于查找已知文章以进行内容审查、归档或相关媒体分析。
- [Video Details (V1) / 视频详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/toutiao/video-details-v1): Retrieves details for a Toutiao video identified by its video ID. Use it to look up a known video for content review, archiving, or related media analysis. / 获取通过视频ID标识的今日头条视频的详细信息。用于查看已知视频以进行内容审核、存档或相关媒体分析。
- [User Profile (V1) / 用户资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/toutiao/user-profile-v1): Retrieves a Toutiao user profile identified by user ID. Use it to look up a known account for creator research, profile review, or related article analysis. / 通过用户ID获取今日头条用户资料。用于查找已知账户以进行创作者研究、资料审查或相关文章分析。
- [User ID (V1) / 用户ID (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/toutiao/user-id-v1): Resolves the user ID associated with a Toutiao profile URL. Use it to convert a known profile link into the identifier required for subsequent user-profile lookups. / 解析与今日头条个人主页URL关联的用户ID。用于将已知的个人主页链接转换为后续用户资料查询所需的标识符。
- [Web Keyword Search (V2) / 网页关键词搜索 (V2)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/toutiao/web-keyword-search-v2): Searches Toutiao web articles by keyword. Use it to discover relevant articles for topic research, media monitoring, or source collection. / 按关键词搜索今日头条网页文章。用于发现相关文章，进行话题研究、媒体监测或素材收集。
  - Limitations and conditions: This endpoint returns only the first page of search results. / 该接口仅返回搜索结果的第一页。

### Zhihu / 知乎

Zhihu answers, columns, articles, and search data for knowledge content analysis and topic discovery. / 知乎回答、专栏、文章和搜索数据，用于知识内容分析和话题发现。

- [Column Article Details (V1) / 专栏文章详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/column-article-details-v1): Retrieve details for a Zhihu column article identified by article ID. Use it to inspect a known article for reading, review, or archiving. / 获取由文章ID标识的知乎专栏文章的详情。用于查看已知文章，进行阅读、审阅或归档。
- [Answer List (V1) / 回答列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/answer-list-v1): Retrieve answers for a Zhihu question with sorting and pagination controls. Use it to browse responses to a known question and continue through additional answer pages. / 获取知乎问题的回答，具有排序和分页控制功能。用于浏览已知问题的回答，并继续查看更多的回答页面。
- [Keyword Search (V1) / 关键词搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/keyword-search-v1): Search Zhihu by keyword with optional result-type, sort, time-interval, topic-display, and offset controls. Use it to find relevant answers, articles, or videos. / 按关键词搜索知乎，可选的搜索结果类型、排序、时间间隔、话题显示和偏移量控制。用于查找相关的回答、文章或视频。
- [Column Article List (V1) / 专栏文章列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/column-article-list-v1): Retrieve articles from a Zhihu column with offset pagination. Use it to browse a known column's publication history and select articles for detail lookup. / 获取知乎专栏的文章，具有偏移分页功能。用于浏览已知专栏的发布历史，并选择文章进行详细查看。
- [User Info (V1) / 用户信息 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-info-v1): Retrieve the public profile for a Zhihu user identified by URL token. Use it to inspect an account found through Zhihu content or relationship data. / 获取由URL令牌标识的知乎用户的公开资料。用于检查通过知乎内容或关系数据发现的账号。
- [User Followees (V1) / 用户关注的人 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-followees-v1): Retrieve accounts followed by a Zhihu user, with offset pagination. Use it to explore the outgoing connections of a known account. / 获取知乎用户关注的账号，具有偏移分页功能。用于探索已知账号的关注关系。
- [User Followers (V1) / 用户关注者 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-followers-v1): Retrieve accounts that follow a Zhihu user, with offset pagination. Use it to explore the audience connections of a known account. / 获取关注知乎用户的账号，具有偏移分页功能。用于探索已知账号的粉丝关系。
- [User Articles (V1) / 用户文章 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-articles-v1): Retrieve articles published by a Zhihu user with offset pagination and publish-time or upvote sorting. Use it to browse a creator's articles in the selected order. / 获取知乎用户发布的文章，具有偏移分页和发布时间或点赞排序功能。用于按所选顺序浏览创作者的文章。
- [User Included Articles (V1) / 用户收藏的文章 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-included-articles-v1): Retrieve the included-article records exposed for a Zhihu user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse that account's included-article list. / 获取知乎用户公开的收录文章记录，具有偏移分页功能。用于浏览该账号的收录文章列表。
- [User Follow Columns (V1) / 用户关注的专栏 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-follow-columns-v1): Retrieve Zhihu columns followed by a user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse the columns associated with a known account's follow activity. / 获取用户关注的知乎专栏，具有偏移分页功能。用于浏览与已知账号关注活动相关的专栏。
- [User Follow Collections (V1) / 用户关注的收藏夹 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-follow-collections-v1): Retrieve Zhihu collections followed by a user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse the collections associated with a known account's follow activity. / 获取用户关注的知乎收藏夹，具有偏移分页功能。用于浏览与已知账号关注活动相关的收藏夹。
- [User Follow Topics (V1) / 用户关注的话题 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/user-follow-topics-v1): Retrieve Zhihu topics followed by a user, with offset pagination. Use it to browse the topics associated with a known account's follow activity. / 获取用户关注的知乎话题，具有偏移分页功能。用于浏览与已知账号关注活动相关的话题。
- [Answer Comments (V1) / 回答评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/answer-comments-v1): Retrieve comments for a Zhihu answer with hottest or latest sorting and offset pagination. Use it to review discussion around a known answer and continue through additional comment pages. / 获取知乎回答的评论，具有最热或最新排序和偏移分页功能。用于查看已知回答的讨论，并继续浏览更多评论页面。
- [Comment Replies (V1) / 评论回复 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/zhihu/comment-replies-v1): Retrieve replies to a Zhihu comment with hottest or latest sorting and offset pagination. Use it to follow discussion under a known comment and continue through additional reply pages. / 使用最热或最新排序和分页偏移获取知乎评论的回复。用于追踪已知评论下的讨论并继续浏览更多回复页。

### Amazon / 亚马逊

Amazon catalog data, reviews, best-seller rankings, and category listings for market research and enrichment. / 亚马逊目录数据、评价、热销排名和分类列表，用于市场研究和数据丰富。

- [Product Search (V1) / 商品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/amazon/product-search-v1): Searches Amazon marketplace products by keyword or ASIN with country, sort, condition, Prime-only, deals, and page controls. Use it to discover products for catalog research, price comparison, or competitive assortment analysis. / 通过关键词或ASIN，结合国家、排序、商品状况、Prime专享、优惠和分页控制搜索亚马逊市场商品。用于发现商品以进行目录研究、价格比较或竞争性品类分析。
- [Product Details (V1) / 商品详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/amazon/product-details-v1): Retrieves details for an Amazon product identified by ASIN in a selected country marketplace. Use it to look up a known listing for catalog review, product comparison, or downstream commerce analysis. / 通过ASIN获取指定国家市场中亚马逊商品的详情。用于查找已知列表以进行目录审查、商品比较或下游商业分析。
- [Product Top Reviews (V1) / 商品热门评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/amazon/product-top-reviews-v1): Retrieves the top reviews for an Amazon product identified by ASIN in a selected country marketplace. Use it to review prominent customer feedback for product research, sentiment analysis, or quality assessment. / 通过ASIN获取指定国家市场中亚马逊商品的热门评论。用于审查突出的客户反馈以进行商品研究、情感分析或质量评估。
- [Best Sellers (V1) / 热销商品 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/amazon/best-sellers-v1): Retrieves paginated Amazon Best Sellers for a category path in a selected country marketplace. Use it to study category leaders, discover popular products, or compare bestseller pages across marketplaces. / 获取指定国家市场中按分类路径的分页亚马逊热销商品。用于研究品类领导者、发现热门商品或跨市场比较热销页面。
- [Products By Category (V1) / 按类别获取商品 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/amazon/products-by-category-v1): Retrieves paginated Amazon products for a numeric category node in a selected country marketplace, with configurable result sorting. Use it to browse a category, compare assortments, or collect category-specific product candidates. / 通过数字分类节点在选定的国家市场中获取分页亚马逊商品，并支持结果排序。用于浏览分类、比较品类或收集特定分类的商品候选。

### Facebook / Facebook

- [Post Search (V1) / 作品搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/facebook/post-search-v1): Searches public Facebook posts by keyword with optional inclusive date-range filters and cursor pagination. - [Get Profile Posts (V1) / 获取资料帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/facebook/get-profile-posts-v1): Retrieves public posts for a Facebook profile ID with cursor pagination.
