- [Post Comments (V1) / 帖子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/facebook/post-comments-v1): Retrieves comments for a Facebook post ID with cursor pagination. Use it to review discussion associated with a known public post or continue through subsequent comment pages. / 使用游标分页获取指定Facebook帖子ID的评论。用于查看与已知公开帖子相关的讨论或继续浏览后续评论页面。
- [Comment Replies (V1) / 评论回复 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/facebook/comment-replies-v1): Retrieves replies to a specific Facebook post comment using the legacy post ID, comment ID, and expansion token. Use it to inspect a known comment's nested discussion. / 使用旧版帖子ID、评论ID和扩展令牌检索特定Facebook帖子评论的回复。用于查看已知评论的嵌套讨论。

### Twitter / Twitter

Twitter profiles and timelines for creator research, account monitoring, and content aggregation. / Twitter资料和时间线，用于创作者研究、账号监控和内容聚合。

- [Search Timeline (V1) / 搜索时间线 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/twitter/search-timeline-v1): Searches X (Twitter) by keyword across top, latest, media, people, or list result modes with cursor pagination. Use it to find public conversations, accounts, media, or lists related to a topic. / 按关键词搜索 X (Twitter)，支持热门、最新、媒体、用户或列表结果模式，使用游标分页。用于查找与话题相关的公开对话、账号、媒体或列表。
- [User Profile (V1) / 用户资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/twitter/user-profile-v1): Retrieves an X (Twitter) user profile identified by its numeric Rest ID. Use it to review a known account before monitoring its posts or conducting creator and account research. / 通过数字 Rest ID 检索 X (Twitter) 用户资料。用于在监控帖子或进行创作者与账号研究前，查看已知账号信息。
- [User Published Posts (V1) / 用户发布帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/twitter/user-published-posts-v1): Retrieves posts published by an X (Twitter) user identified by Rest ID, with cursor pagination. Use it to browse a known account's timeline or continue through its public post history. / 通过 Rest ID 检索 X (Twitter) 用户发布的帖子，使用游标分页。用于浏览已知账号的时间线或继续获取其公开帖子历史。
- [Post Comments (V1) / 帖子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/twitter/post-comments-v1): Retrieves the latest comments for an X (Twitter) post identified by tweet ID, with cursor pagination. Use it to review recent discussion on a known post and continue through additional comment pages. / 通过推文 ID 检索 X (Twitter) 帖子的最新评论，使用游标分页。用于查看已知帖子的近期讨论，并翻页获取更多评论。
- [Post Detail (V1) / 帖子详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/twitter/post-detail-v1): Retrieves the full detail of an X (Twitter) post identified by its tweet ID. Use it to inspect a known post after finding it through search, a user timeline, or an existing post URL. / 获取由推文 ID 标识的 X（Twitter）帖子的完整详情。在通过搜索、用户时间线或现有帖子 URL 找到已知帖子后，使用此接口检查该帖子。

### LinkedIn / LinkedIn

LinkedIn professional profiles, user activity posts, and post comments for professional research and content analysis. / LinkedIn专业资料、用户活动帖子和帖子评论，用于专业研究和内容分析。

- [People Search (V1) / 人员搜索 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/linkedin/people-search-v1): This LinkedIn people-search endpoint is deprecated because the capability is no longer available. Existing integrations should stop sending requests. / 此LinkedIn人员搜索接口已弃用，因为该功能不再可用。现有集成应停止发送请求。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃
- [User Profile (V1) / 用户资料 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/linkedin/user-profile-v1): Retrieves a LinkedIn profile by username, including documented core profile fields such as name and headline. Use it to inspect a person's professional background or before requesting published posts. / 通过用户名检索 LinkedIn 个人资料，包括核心资料字段，如姓名和头衔。用于查看用户职业背景，或在请求已发布帖子前获取信息。
- [Company Employees (V1) / 公司员工 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/linkedin/company-employees-v1): This LinkedIn company-employee endpoint is deprecated because the capability is no longer available. Existing integrations should stop sending requests. / 此LinkedIn公司员工接口已弃用，因为该功能不再可用。现有集成应停止发送请求。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃
- [User Published Posts (V1) / 用户发布帖子 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/linkedin/user-published-posts-v1): Retrieves posts published, commented on, or reacted to by a LinkedIn member using a profile URL, activity type, offset, and pagination token. Use it to review public professional activity and continue through additional result pages. / 使用个人资料URL、活动类型、偏移量和分页令牌检索LinkedIn成员发布、评论或回应过的帖子。用于查看公开的专业活动，并继续浏览额外的结果页面。
- [Post Reactions (V1) / 帖子反应 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/linkedin/post-reactions-v1): This LinkedIn post-reaction-record endpoint is deprecated because the capability is no longer available. Existing integrations should stop sending requests. / 此LinkedIn帖子回应记录接口已弃用，因为该功能不再可用。现有集成应停止发送请求。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃
- [Post Comments (V1) / 帖子评论 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/linkedin/post-comments-v1): Retrieves LinkedIn comments for an activity post with relevance or recent sorting, page-based navigation, a pagination token, and optional share URN. Use it to review public discussion around known professional content. / 检索活动帖子的LinkedIn评论，支持按相关性或最新排序、分页导航、分页令牌和可选的分享URN。用于查看围绕已知专业内容的公开讨论。

### Beike / 贝壳

Beike neighborhood and resale housing data for property search, listing analysis, and market research. / 贝壳小区和二手房数据，用于房产搜索、挂牌分析和市场研究。

- [Resale Housing Details (V1) / 二手房详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/beike/resale-housing-details-v1): Retrieves a Beike resale-housing listing by city ID and house code. Use it to inspect a known second-hand property listing in a specific city. / 通过城市ID和房屋编码检索贝壳二手房挂牌房源。用于查看特定城市中的已知二手房源。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃
- [Resale Housing List (V1) / 二手房列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/beike/resale-housing-list-v1): Retrieves Beike resale-housing listings for a city with optional condition filters and offset pagination. Use it to browse second-hand properties in a selected market. / 检索指定城市的贝壳二手房挂牌房源，支持可选的筛选条件和偏移分页。用于在选定市场中浏览二手房源。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃
- [Community List (V1) / 小区列表 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/beike/community-list-v1): Retrieves Beike residential communities for a city with optional condition filters and offset pagination. Use it to browse housing communities in a selected city. / 检索指定城市的贝壳住宅小区，支持可选的筛选条件和偏移分页。用于浏览选定城市中的住宅小区。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃

### IMDb / IMDb

IMDb title details, rankings, cast, reviews, awards, releases, and streaming metadata for media intelligence. / IMDb标题详情、排名、演员、评价、奖项、发布和流媒体元数据，用于媒体情报。

- [Release Expectation (V1) / 发行预期 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/release-expectation-v1): Retrieves IMDb release-expectation information for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to monitor a title's release context or support release-planning research. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb预期上映信息。用于监控标题的上映背景或支持上映规划研究。
- [Extended Details (V1) / 扩展详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/extended-details-v1): Retrieves extended IMDb details for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to enrich a title catalog or perform deeper research after a basic lookup. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb扩展详情。用于丰富标题目录或在基本查询后进行更深入的研究。
- [Top Cast and Crew (V1) / 主要演员和工作人员 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/top-cast-and-crew-v1): Retrieves IMDb top cast and crew information for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to research principal talent or enrich title credits. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb主要演员和剧组成员信息。用于研究主要人才或丰富标题演职员信息。
- [Base Info (V1) / 基本信息 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/base-info-v1): Retrieves base IMDb information for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to perform a lightweight title lookup or populate basic catalog context. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb基本信息。用于执行轻量级标题查询或填充基本目录上下文。
- [Redux Overview (V1) / Redux概览 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/redux-overview-v1): Retrieves the IMDb Redux overview for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to obtain a consolidated title overview for catalog review or content research. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb Redux概览。用于获取整合的标题概览，以进行目录审查或内容研究。
- ['Did You Know' Insights (V1) / '你知道吗'洞察 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/did-you-know-insights-v1): Retrieves IMDb 'Did You Know' information for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to research title trivia and add editorial context. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb“你知道吗”信息。用于研究标题趣闻并添加编辑上下文。
- [Critics Review Summary (V1) / 影评人评论摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/critics-review-summary-v1): Retrieves the IMDb critics-review summary for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to review critical reception or compare titles during research. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb影评人评论摘要。用于审查评论反响或在研究期间比较标题。
- [Awards Summary (V1) / 奖项摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/awards-summary-v1): Retrieves the IMDb awards summary for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to research a title's awards record or support awards-focused catalog review. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb奖项摘要。用于研究标题的获奖记录或支持以奖项为重点的目录审查。
- [User Reviews Summary (V1) / 用户评价摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/user-reviews-summary-v1): Retrieves the IMDb user-reviews summary for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to review audience reception or support title comparison and research. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb用户评论摘要。用于审查观众反响或支持标题比较和研究。
- [Plot Summary (V1) / 剧情摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/plot-summary-v1): Retrieves IMDb plot information for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to review a movie or series storyline or enrich title descriptions. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb剧情信息。用于查看电影或电视剧的故事线或丰富标题描述。
- [Contribution Questions (V1) / 贡献问题 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/contribution-questions-v1): Retrieves IMDb contribution questions associated with a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to review available prompts for title-data contribution workflows. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索与标题ID关联的IMDb贡献问题。用于查看可用于标题数据贡献工作流的提示。
- [Details (V1) / 详情 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/details-v1): Retrieves IMDb title details for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to support detailed title research or enrich a movie and television catalog. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb标题详情。用于支持详细的标题研究或丰富影视目录。
- [Box Office Summary (V1) / 票房摘要 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/box-office-summary-v1): Retrieves the IMDb box-office summary for a title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to research reported theatrical performance or compare titles. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索指定标题ID的IMDb票房摘要。用于研究报告的院线表现或比较标题。
- [Recommendations (V1) / 推荐 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/recommendations-v1): Retrieves IMDb titles similar to a specified title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to support related-title discovery, recommendations, or catalog curation. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索与指定标题ID相似的IMDb标题。用于支持相关标题发现、推荐或目录策划。
- [Streaming Picks (V1) / 流媒体精选 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/streaming-picks-v1): Retrieves IMDb streaming picks for Prime Video using selected language and country preferences. Use it to explore streaming titles for discovery, catalog review, or watchlist research. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索Prime Video的IMDb流媒体精选。用于探索流媒体标题以进行发现、目录审查或待看清单研究。
- [News by Category (V1) / 分类新闻 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/news-by-category-v1): Retrieves IMDb news for a selected top, movie, TV, or celebrity category using language and country preferences. Use it to monitor entertainment news or research a specific category. / 使用语言和国家/地区偏好检索所选热门、电影、电视或名人类别的IMDb新闻。用于监控娱乐新闻或研究特定类别。
- [Chart Rankings (V1) / 榜单排名 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/chart-rankings-v1): Retrieves the IMDb Top 250 movie or TV chart selected by ranking type using language and country preferences. Use it to monitor chart positions or compare highly ranked titles. / 使用语言和国家/地区偏好检索按排名类型选择的IMDb Top 250电影或电视榜单。用于监控榜单排名或比较高排名标题。
- [Countries of Origin (V1) / 原产国 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/imdb/countries-of-origin-v1): Retrieves countries of origin associated with an IMDb title ID using selected language and country preferences. Use it to enrich regional catalog metadata or support origin-based analysis. / 使用所选语言和国家/地区偏好检索与IMDb标题ID关联的原产国家/地区。用于丰富区域目录元数据或支持基于原产地的分析。

### LLM / LLM

Large-language-model answer collection from supported client experiences for response monitoring and comparison. / 大型语言模型答案收集，来自支持的客户端体验，用于响应监控和比较。

- [Doubao Answer (V1) / 豆包回答 (V1)](https://docs.justoneapi.com/en/api/llm/doubao-answer-v1): Requests a Doubao web answer for a submitted keyword or question. Use it to collect a generated answer for research and information-gathering workflows. / 为提交的关键词或问题请求豆包网页回答。用于收集生成的答案以进行研究或信息收集工作流。
  - Status: Deprecated / 状态：已废弃

## Response Structure
All documented response bodies use JSON (`application/json`).
JSON responses commonly use the following envelope when declared by the endpoint:
- `code`: 0 for success, non-zero for errors.
- `message`: Error description.
- `data`: Response payload.

## Rate Limiting & Quotas
Check individual API pages for specific rate limits. 302/303 codes indicate limit issues.
